snippet.title: Focus Grove || Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Focus Grove officially releases on June 1st, 2026 💛
Build your cozy forest farm while you work, study, create, or relax. Use pomodoro focus sessions, to-do lists, ambient sounds, habit tracking, mindful prompts, and more – all alongside adorable Woodlings growing the grove with you.
A cozy productivity game designed to help you focus gently, rest mindfully, and grow at your own pace 🌱
💛Wishlist now and prepare to Grow in the Grove.💛
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4030830/Focus_Grove/ 

Discord  https://discord.com/invite/73Q9DMZqGg  
Instagram https://www.instagram.com/focusgrove
